## What changed

Describe the smallest useful change and the public problem it addresses.

## Evidence and provenance

- [ ] Every new or changed factual statement has a source or an explicit status.
- [ ] Public URLs and exact locators are provided where available.
- [ ] Discovery, citation, influence, teaching, collaboration and practical use have not been collapsed into one relation.

## Publication safety

- [ ] No credentials, private documents, client information, personal data, internal paths or private-system URLs are included.
- [ ] Third-party text is linked and summarised rather than republished beyond its licence.
- [ ] Identity resolution has been checked before adding person-level lineage or influence statements.

## Human and automated responsibility

- [ ] A named human sponsor has checked the sources and diff.
- [ ] Any material use of an LLM or automated process is disclosed here.
- [ ] The contribution does not request direct agent push, autonomous merge or autonomous release rights.

## Validation

- [ ] `make validate` passes.
- [ ] The public site has been checked at desktop and narrow widths where the interface changed.
- [ ] The curator has reviewed the wording, boundary and release effect.
